body: Implement Workstream 3 post-merge hardening polish from HANDOFF.md: (1) add download_url(*) and unsandboxed(*) to base readonly and builder permissions.deny in lib/role-settings.mjs and update test/role-settings.test.mjs and test/ndjson-worker.test.mjs; (2) align NdjsonWorkerDaemon._requiresContainment() in lib/ndjson-worker.mjs so role === 'builder' unconditionally enters prepareBuilderContainment() unless an explicit test-only seam gated by isTestExecution() is passed, and route this.userHome through resolveUserHome() from lib/agy.mjs; (3) rename versionAutoDisableOk to belowFloorRejectedOk in evals/v13-enhancements-bench.mjs, evals/runner.mjs, and any referencing tests.
title: Post-merge v2.0 hardening polish: role-settings denies, non-bypassable NdjsonWorkerDaemon containment, and eval key rename
